record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, multiply each nonpadding input embedding by s_i=clip((c_i/g)^(-0.1),0.8,1.2), where c_i is the item's supplied-training interaction count clamped to one and g is the geometric mean of these counts over training-observed items. Mild frequency attenuation may reduce common-item dominance in recurrent updates. Keep candidate embeddings unchanged. Store counts/scales for identical inference; preserve embedding parameters, topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer.
